package fixture

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/internal/testbin"
)

// The allowed shape: the helper links the built program into the fixture and
// copies only where a link is impossible.
func TestFixturePlacesByLink(t *testing.T) {
	if err := testbin.Place("built", "placed"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
